agent_id.description: The task ID of a finished subagent, as start_agent answered it, such as agent-k3n8q5r1.

action.description: apply merges the subagent's changes into the workspace as uncommitted changes; discard drops them.

paths.description: With apply, merge only the changed files these paths name, files or directories relative to the workspace, and leave the others mergeable; every changed file when omitted.
